text:
Sam Nguyen: Hi all — starting next Monday (mid-month) and trying to figure out PTO accrual, holiday pay pro-rates, and a relocation reimbursement I need to submit. A few quick Qs: 1) How is PTO pro-rated for partial first month? 2) We have a floating holiday coming up — do I get prorated holiday pay if I start after the holiday cutoff? 3) Where do I upload relocation receipts and what's the timeline for reimbursement?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, @Sam! Short answers: 1) PTO is pro-rated based on your start date in the calendar month — you accrue a proportional amount for that month which will show in Rippling under Time Off. 2) Floating holidays are pro-rated too if your start date is after the eligibility date; if you start before the cutoff for the quarter you get the full holiday. Tell me your exact start date and which holiday you're asking about and I'll check. 3) Relocation receipts: upload to Rippling > Documents > Category: Expenses > Subtype: Relocation and then email relocations@redwood.com with the ticket number. Finance processes reimbursements on the 15th and last day of the month (paid out on the next payroll cycle).

Sam Nguyen: Thanks. Start date is 2026-04-05 and the company-wide spring floating holiday is 2026-04-03 (so I start after). If it's pro-rated will I get any portion?

Maya (People Ops): Since the floating holiday falls before your start date you won't be eligible for that quarter's holiday. We prorate quarterly-allocated floating days based on start month. See policy snippet: "Employees must be active on the payroll run that includes the holiday to receive full holiday pay; otherwise prorated per company accrual rules."

Jordan (Payroll): To add: your first paycheck may be impacted by form completion. Make sure I-9 and direct deposit are submitted. If your direct deposit isn't active by payroll cutoff we issue a paycard for the first cycle. Also, health/dental premiums are deducted starting the paycheck after your benefits effective date. If you enroll during onboarding and your effective date is your start date, expect premium deductions to appear on the second paycheck.

Sam Nguyen: Got it. I do have a question about relocation receipts: I paid for movers and also had flights. Can I bundle multiple receipts in one PDF? Any naming conventions?

Tina (Benefits): Relocation is handled by Finance, but quick note: employer-paid relocation reimbursements are taxable. For documentation: you can combine receipts into one PDF but each expense should be clearly labeled. Suggested filename: `sam_nguyen_relocation_apr2026.pdf` and include a cover page listing amounts and dates. Upload path: Rippling > Documents > Category: Expenses > Subtype: Relocation.

Finance Bot: Received reloc docs queued. Ticket #FIN-3340. Reminder: Reimbursements processed on payroll runs: 15th and EOM. Expect reimbursement on next payroll after approval.

Sam Nguyen: I uploaded `sam_nguyen_relocation_apr2026.pdf` and attached a cover page. Also, my medical plan shows an "eligibility pending" flag. I enrolled during onboarding; is there a waiting period?

Tina (Benefits): Enrollment during onboarding typically has no waiting period — eligibility pending means Benefits team is verifying your docs. If everything is in order we make coverage effective as of your start date and premiums begin on the following payroll. If verification requires docs (e.g., ID or dependent proof) we'll DM you.

Jordan (Payroll): FYI I-9/Direct deposit cutoff is payroll_cutoff@company calendar. If you missed the cutoff DM me and I'll confirm whether first paycheck will be paycard or delayed.

Sam Nguyen: Thanks everyone. Last one: if I have out-of-pocket moving expenses I want to claim under relocation, is there a per-item cap?

Maya (People Ops): Most standard employee-paid moving expenses are reimbursable up to agreed relocation allowance in your offer. Check your offer letter for the exact cap and the policy link: https://intranet.redwood/relo-policy. If anything's unclear, send your offer doc to relocations@redwood.com and we'll reconcile.

Sam Nguyen: Appreciate it — uploaded receipts and double-checked my forms. Will ping if anything else crops up. :slightly_smiling_face:
